notes: Tail case, all units re-examined. U1/U2 masks are olive T-shirts but refs named whole 'officers' (and U2 replaced a person with a uniform): refs now name the T-shirts; U2 v2 mask = T-shirt with the crossed forearms excluded (SAM3 t1_1), payload a structural garment change. U3 dog ref made specific. U4 boot belonged to the same marine as U1 (independence violation) and ref said 'boots' for one boot: retargeted to the woman marine's front boot (SAM3 tracker, v2 mask) with a concrete payload.
